topic.title: Teammate deleted their Kaggle account. Am I still eligible to participate?

messages.content: Yes, you're still eligible to participate. However if it's found that the teammate violated competition rules prior to deleting their account, your team may still be subject to disqualification.
messages.rawMarkdown: Yes, you're still eligible to participate. However if it's found that the teammate violated competition rules prior to deleting their account, your team may still be subject to disqualification.

messages.content: May be contact kaggle support, send em a mail.
messages.rawMarkdown: May be contact kaggle support, send em a mail.

messages.content:
Hi everyone,

I formed a team with one of my uni friends for this competition. However, my teammate changed their mind about participating and deleted their Kaggle account.

I am still listed as a member of the team, and I would like to continue participating in the competition. Does anyone know whether I am still eligible to participate?

Any advice would be greatly appreciated. Thank you!
